title: Finite matrix extension to one neighbourhood
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and P,Q cochain complexes of O_Y-modules [def-pc-derived-category], supported in integer intervals [a,b] and [c,e]. Assume each term is zero or isomorphic to a finite free sheaf [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. For y in Y and a chain map f:T(P) -> T(Q), with T the termwise pullback to Spec O_{Y,y} [def-pc-derived-pullback], there exist an open U containing y and a chain map fU:R_U(P) -> R_U(Q) such that S_U(fU)=E_U(P).hom ; f ; E_U(Q).inv, where R_U is open restriction, S_U is stalk pullback on U, and E_U is [def-pc-stalk-restriction-complex-iso]. This asserts existence on one open only.

proof.text: Apply lem-pc-finite-free-stalk-degreewise-lift to the degreewise components f.f. Obtain U, its membership proof, and a family g whose stalk components are E_U(P).hom ; f ; E_U(Q).inv.

The conjugate E_U(P).hom ; f ; E_U(Q).inv is a chain map. Rewrite using the degreewise equations of the lift and use its Hom.comm equation to prove that the stalk of g commutes with differentials. Apply lem-pc-finite-free-stalk-degreewise-shrink to obtain V and a degreewise family k commuting with differentials, with the prescribed comparison to the stalk of g.

Build fV using CochainComplex.ofHom k hk. To check the stalk equality, use HomologicalComplex.hom_ext. In each degree substitute the formula for the stalk of k and then the formula for the stalk of g. Cancel the inverse/hom pairs of E_U(P) and E_U(Q), using their iso identities evaluated at that degree. The remaining composite is E_V(P).hom ; f ; E_V(Q).inv.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_chainMap_of_stalk_local
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (P Q : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ)
    (a b c e : ℤ)
    (hPa : P.IsStrictlyGE a) (hPb : P.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (hQc : Q.IsStrictlyGE c) (hQe : Q.IsStrictlyLE e)
    (hPfree : ∀ n : ℤ, IsZero (P.X n) ∨ ∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty
      (P.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (hQfree : ∀ n : ℤ, IsZero (Q.X n) ∨ ∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty
      (Q.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (y : Y)
    (f : ((Modules.pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P ⟶
      ((Modules.pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj Q) :
    ∃ (U : Y.Opens), ∃ (hyU : y ∈ U), ∃ (fU :
      ((restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P ⟶
      ((restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Q),
      let S := (Modules.pullback (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y ‹y ∈ U›)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
      let eP := (stalkRestrictionComplexIso U y ‹y ∈ U›).app P
      let eQ := (stalkRestrictionComplexIso U y ‹y ∈ U›).app Q
      S.map fU = eP.hom ≫ f ≫ eQ.inv
